expedition.advancement.story.finale.desc: The three last guardians of the Tree have fallen
expedition.advancement.story.root.desc: The expedition's story: chapters and their guardians
expedition.garrison.cleared: ✔ Dungeon cleared. Its blocks can be broken now.
expedition.garrison.protected: The dungeon is not cleared: defeat its garrison first.
expedition.reset.done: ⚔ Dungeon restored: NG+%s. The garrison is back.
expedition.reset.not_here: The beacon only works inside a cleared dungeon.
expedition.reset.started: The dungeon is being restored… its garrison will return stronger.
expedition.route.01_old_dungeon.text: First outing: a small underground dungeon (undead or spiders) near camp — dig down at the cross. On foot. Bring torches and food.
expedition.route.01_old_dungeon.title: Old dungeon
expedition.route.02_crypt.text: A crypt of acolytes and corrupted illagers. Clear the garrison.
expedition.route.02_crypt.title: Crypt
expedition.route.03_wrought_chamber.text: Underground sleeps the Ferrous Wroughtnaut, the first real boss. Strike its back after it swings.
expedition.route.04_nether_fortress.text: You need blaze rods for the Blaze Burner — no brass without them. The fortress is in the Nether realm, under the scorched plateau (marked on the map).
expedition.route.05_mossy_temple.text: The Overgrown Colossus in the jungle. Far away: time for your first balloon.
expedition.route.05_mossy_temple.title: Mossy temple
expedition.route.06_underworld_arena.tex: The Underworld Knight and soul skeletons. Fire resistance is a must.
expedition.route.07_foundry.text: An industrial dungeon with parts for TFMG steel. Fly an airship.
expedition.route.07_foundry.title: Foundry
expedition.route.08_cursed_pyramid.text: The Ancient Remnant in the desert. Sandstorms, traps, koboleton.
expedition.route.08_cursed_pyramid.title: Cursed pyramid
expedition.route.09_frostbitten_temple.t: The Frostbitten Golem in the snow. Warm gear and hot food.
expedition.route.10_ocean_monument.text: The Elder Guardian underwater. You need a submarine (Deep Seas).
expedition.route.10_ocean_monument.title: Ocean monument
expedition.route.11_pirate_ship.text: Captain Cornelia's pirate ship in the ice maze.
expedition.route.11_pirate_ship.title: Ship in the ice
expedition.route.12_kraken_ship.text: The Kraken at a wrecked ship. You need a warship with cannons.
expedition.route.12_kraken_ship.title: Kraken ship
expedition.route.13_sky_whale.text: A flying whale-ship. Reachable only by air.
expedition.route.13_sky_whale.title: Sky whale
expedition.route.14_burning_arena.text: Ignis in the caverns of the Nether realm. Fire, lava and shields.
expedition.route.14_burning_arena.title: Burning arena
expedition.route.15_soul_blacksmith.text: The Netherite Monstrosity: a heavy fight, bring your best armor.
expedition.route.16_frosted_prison.text: Maledictus, a cursed warrior in a frozen prison.
expedition.route.16_frosted_prison.title: Frosted prison
expedition.route.17_stronghold.text: Clear the stronghold. There is no End portal any more: the End is a realm of this world, reached on foot or by air.
expedition.route.17_stronghold.title: Stronghold
expedition.route.18_ender_dragon.text: The dragon sleeps above the End castle in the End realm. Come near and it rises.
expedition.route.18_ender_dragon.title: Ender Dragon
expedition.route.19_ruined_citadel.text: The Ender Guardian on the islands of the End realm. There is void under the islands: you need a ship.
expedition.route.19_ruined_citadel.title: Ruined citadel
expedition.route.20_space_station.text: A station of flameborn guards. Prepare a rocket (Cosmonautics): titanium and the Moon are next.
expedition.route.20_space_station.title: Space station
expedition.route.21_ancient_factory.text: The Harbinger, a wither machine. Missiles and heavy cannons.
expedition.route.22_sunken_city.text: The Leviathan in the depths. A submarine is a must.
expedition.route.22_sunken_city.title: Sunken city
expedition.route.23_acropolis.title: Acropolis
expedition.route.24_malkuth.text: Malkuth in the deep ocean: fire and ice.
expedition.route.24_malkuth.title: Malkuth arena
expedition.route.25_chesed.title: Chesed arena
expedition.route.26_geburah.text: Geburah by the cities of the End realm.
expedition.route.26_geburah.title: Geburah arena
expedition.route.27_lich_tower.text: The Night Lich in the cold lands.
expedition.route.27_lich_tower.title: Lich tower
expedition.route.28_void_blossom.text: The Void Blossom deep in the caves.
expedition.route.28_void_blossom.title: Void blossom
expedition.route.29_nether_gauntlet.text: The Nether Gauntlet, a living armored glove.
expedition.route.30_obsidilith.text: The Obsidilith in the End realm.
expedition.route.30_obsidilith.title: Obsidilith
expedition.route.31_wither.text: The Wither is sealed in a sanctum in the Nether realm. Come near and it rises.
expedition.route.31_wither.title: The Wither
expedition.route.32_warped_nest.title: Warped Fungussus Nest
expedition.route.34_monastery.title: Sculptor Monastery
expedition.route.35_sandworm_nest.title: Sandworm Nest
expedition.route.36_ruined_pyramid.title: Ruined Pyramid
expedition.route.39_yeti_hideout.title: Yeti Hideout
expedition.route.40_frostmaw_den.title: Frostmaw Den
expedition.route.42_soul_fortress.title: Soul Fortress Remains
expedition.route.43_dragon_tower.title: Infernal Dragon Tower
expedition.route.44_shulker_tower.title: Shulker Tower
expedition.route.45_cloudy_temple.title: Cloudy Temple
expedition.route.47_lich_prison.title: Lich Prison
expedition.route.48_ancient_tower.title: Ancient Tower Remains
expedition.route.49_naga_courtyard.text: The Twilight Forest. The Naga guards her courtyard.
expedition.route.49_naga_courtyard.title: The Naga Courtyard
expedition.route.50_tf_lich_tower.text: The Twilight Forest. The Lich waits atop his tower; his shield holds while his shades live.
expedition.route.50_tf_lich_tower.title: The Twilight Lich Tower
expedition.route.51_labyrinth.text: The Twilight Forest swamp. The Minoshroom waits deep in the labyrinth.
expedition.route.51_labyrinth.title: The Minoshroom Labyrinth
expedition.route.52_hydra_lair.text: The Twilight fire swamp. The Hydra has three heads: strike them.
expedition.route.52_hydra_lair.title: The Hydra Lair
expedition.route.53_knight_stronghold.te: The dark forest. Phantom knights deep in the stronghold.
expedition.route.54_dark_tower.text: The Twilight Forest. The Ur-Ghast at the top of the tower.
expedition.route.54_dark_tower.title: The Dark Tower
expedition.route.55_yeti_cave.text: The snowy Twilight forest. The Alpha Yeti in its cave.
expedition.route.55_yeti_cave.title: The Yeti Cave
expedition.route.56_aurora_palace.text: The Twilight glacier. The Snow Queen in her ice palace.
expedition.route.56_aurora_palace.title: The Aurora Palace
expedition.route.57_bronze_dungeon.text: The sky islands. The Slider inside the island; you need the bronze key.
expedition.route.57_bronze_dungeon.title: The Bronze Dungeon
expedition.route.58_silver_dungeon.text: The sky islands. The Valkyrie Queen in the cloud temple.
expedition.route.58_silver_dungeon.title: The Silver Dungeon
expedition.route.59_gold_dungeon.text: The sky islands. The Sun Spirit at the heart of the golden island.
expedition.route.59_gold_dungeon.title: The Gold Dungeon
expedition.route.not_placed: finding a place for the dungeon — a cross will appear on the atlas
expedition.route.place_failed: No place found for the dungeon: open the journal again.
expedition.story.act.1.1: Stop twitching, mortal. It was I who raised you from your grave. I am the Tree, and my roots once held six worlds apart.
expedition.story.act.1.2: The Rift split my trunk. The worlds fell onto one another and grew together at the seams, and I am withering. I need hands. Yours will do.
expedition.story.act.1.3: In every guardian of the old worlds a root of mine is woven. They have gone mad and drink the last of my sap, and the seams tear beneath them. Kill them and the roots come back to me.
expedition.story.act.1.4: Throw a fireseed into a campfire and the flame will reach for the nearest of them. Expect no reward. Keep the hearts if you like: I only need the roots.
expedition.story.act.1.subtitle: The first knots near the grave
expedition.story.act.1.title: Chapter I. Awakening
expedition.story.act.2.1: The roots are coming back. Faintly, but I feel them. Do not get proud: the start was easy.
expedition.story.act.2.2: Further on the seams run hot. There the Nether grew into your forests, and in its fortresses my guardians of fire forgot whom they serve.
expedition.story.act.2.3: The Twilight Forest is here too. Its guardians are older than all your kind; the naga at least remembers whose root it guards.
expedition.story.act.2.4: A captain in the ice, a mossy colossus, a fungal giant: all of them knots of mine. The sooner the better.
expedition.story.act.2.5: Go. I do not know how to wait, and I do not like to.
expedition.story.act.2.subtitle: The Nether and the twilight close to home
expedition.story.act.2.title: Chapter II. Fire beneath the seams
expedition.story.act.3.1: You are still alive. I admit I wagered otherwise.
expedition.story.act.3.2: Here the End and the Aether grew onto the seams. Their guardians hold my roots above the clouds and over the void.
expedition.story.act.3.3: The dragon of the End is the first knot I ever tied, and the oldest. It remembers me. And hates me.
expedition.story.act.3.4: The Underworld Knight swore to guard my root forever. Forever is over.
expedition.story.act.3.5: You will not get there without wings. Build some. That, it seems, you can do.
expedition.story.act.3.subtitle: The End, the Aether and the dragon
expedition.story.act.3.title: Chapter III. Above the clouds and the void
expedition.story.act.4.1: Half the roots are home and the ground trembles less. Did you notice? Of course not.
expedition.story.act.4.2: Further on the seams tear harder: a whale in the sky, the Kraken's ship, the liches' towers. The knots there are thicker and angrier.
expedition.story.act.4.3: One lich wove my root into his own chest, thinking it would make him immortal. A fool.
expedition.story.act.4.4: The Ender Guardian sits in a citadel that was built for me. Now he thinks it is his.
expedition.story.act.4.5: Do not wait for praise. Wait for the next flame.
expedition.story.act.4.subtitle: Thicker knots, and angrier
expedition.story.act.4.title: Chapter IV. The torn lands
expedition.story.act.5.1: Forges burn beneath the seams. There, at my word, the shackles of the worlds were forged.
expedition.story.act.5.2: Ignis and the Netherite Monstrosity are my smiths. Once they forged order. Now they forge only spite.
expedition.story.act.5.3: The cloud temple, the fallen kingdom, the void blossom: knots that guard the approach to the Ancients.
expedition.story.act.5.4: The Otherside is here too. It is quiet there. Make no noise: the warden of the deep hears everything.
expedition.story.act.5.5: You have grown stronger. Not enough to interest me.
expedition.story.act.5.subtitle: My smiths and the approach to the Ancients
expedition.story.act.5.title: Chapter V. Forges and the void
expedition.story.act.6.1: Now the Ancients. The first guardians I ever grew, and the first to betray me.
expedition.story.act.6.2: It was they who let the Rift in: they tore at my roots to be free. Freedom does not suit them.
expedition.story.act.6.3: The Harbinger in the ancient factory, the Leviathan in the sunken city, the Wither in a sanctum of the Nether.
expedition.story.act.6.4: Their knots are the thickest of all. When they come back, I can reach my last branches again.
expedition.story.act.6.5: Do not fail me. Just once I would like to be right about a mortal.
expedition.story.act.6.subtitle: Those who let the Rift in
expedition.story.act.6.title: Chapter VI. The Ancients
expedition.story.act.7.1: Three are left. Kingdom, Mercy, Severity: my last branches.
expedition.story.act.7.2: They have not gone mad. They hold what is left, and will not give it up without a fight.
expedition.story.act.7.3: Malkuth, Chesed, Geburah… Once they sang in tune with me.
expedition.story.act.7.4: Scylla at the Acropolis is mine too, but her knot can wait till last.
expedition.story.act.7.5: Go. It is the last thing I will ask of you. And the first I may thank you for.
expedition.story.act.7.subtitle: Kingdom, Mercy and Severity
expedition.story.act.7.title: Chapter VII. The Tree
expedition.story.arrive.01_old_dungeon.1: An old dungeon. The Rotting Warden, a huge ghoul, was the first to guard my root by the place you died. It has rotted; the root it still holds. When it roars, step back.
expedition.story.arrive.02_crypt.1: A crypt. The Nightmare is a shade I set to keep watch over the dead. Now it wanders among them itself. Keep it in sight: it comes from behind.
expedition.story.arrive.03_wrought_chamb: The Wrought Chamber. The Ferrous Wroughtnaut is armour into which I wove a root instead of a soul. Hit its back when its axe gets stuck.
expedition.story.arrive.04_nether_fortre: A Nether fortress. Its commander is an ignited revenant, bone that burns with my fire. It kept the seam between the Nether and your land. Do not stand before it: it breathes ash.
The mossy temple. The Colossus is a stone I covered in moss and set to keep the jungle. It sleeps until you come near.
expedition.story.arrive.06_underworld_ar: The Underworld arena. The Knight swore to me to guard the root until the end of time. While wisps burn round him he parries every blow. Wait for his blade to stick, then strike.
expedition.story.arrive.07_foundry.1: The foundry. The Prowler is a machine that dug ore for my forges. No one stopped it, so it carries on. Keep away from its fire.
expedition.story.arrive.08_cursed_pyrami: The cursed pyramid. The Ancient Remnant is a guardian of the Ancients' deserts. It sleeps until you bring back the Necklace of the Desert: it lies in the pyramid's suspicious sand.
expedition.story.arrive.09_frostbitten_t: The ice temple. The frostbitten golem is ice I told to keep a root forever. The ice took it literally.
expedition.story.arrive.10_ocean_monumen: The ocean monument. The Coralssus is a coral giant that held my root on the sea floor. The sea grew into it, and it into the sea. Bring water breathing.
expedition.story.arrive.11_pirate_ship.1: A ship in the ice. Captain Cornelia drowned with her crew and clung to my root so as not to sink. Strike her right after she swings her anchor.
expedition.story.arrive.12_kraken_ship.1: The Kraken's ship. The Kraken dragged my root into the deep; the ship above is bait. Do not stand at the rail.
expedition.story.arrive.13_sky_whale.1: The sky whale. A captain seized the whale that carried my root across the sky, and decided the whale was his.
expedition.story.arrive.14_burning_arena: The burning arena. Ignis is my smith of fire; he rises as soon as you enter. He burns through shields: carry a spare.
expedition.story.arrive.15_soul_blacksmi: The soul forge. The Netherite Monstrosity forged the shackles of the worlds at my word. Keep to its side and drink fire resistance.
expedition.story.arrive.16_frosted_priso: The frosted prison. Maledictus is a cursed warrior the Ancients locked away here along with my root.
expedition.story.arrive.17_stronghold.1: A stronghold. The gatekeeper golem stands by the frame of a portal that is no more, guarding a door to nowhere. And my root.
The End castle. The dragon is the first knot I ever tied, and the oldest. Break the crystals on the pillars, or it will keep healing.
expedition.story.arrive.19_ruined_citade: The ruined citadel. The Ender Guardian sits in a citadel that was built for me. Shoot from range; up close strike only after its blow.
expedition.story.arrive.20_space_station: The space station. The Pursuer is a thing that came from beyond the sky at the scent of my root. It will not let go.
expedition.story.arrive.21_ancient_facto: The ancient factory. The Harbinger is one of the Ancients. It sleeps until you give it a Nether Star: the Wither leaves one. Awake, it burns with beams: hide behind pillars.
expedition.story.arrive.22_sunken_city.1: The sunken city. The Leviathan is an Ancient that dragged the city to the bottom along with my root. Out of the water it cannot be hurt: fight in the water.
expedition.story.arrive.23_acropolis.1: The Acropolis by the sea. Scylla is a daughter of storms who held my root in the sea foam. Do not strike head-on: from the front she parries.
expedition.story.arrive.24_malkuth.1: Malkuth, the Kingdom, is the branch that held the earth. Touch his sign in the middle of the arena. He shifts between fire and ice.
expedition.story.arrive.25_chesed.1: Chesed, Mercy, is the branch that held life. Touch her sign. Break the crystals around her and her guard will fall.
expedition.story.arrive.26_geburah.1: Geburah, Severity, is the branch that held the void. Touch her sign. Stay away from the edge.
expedition.story.arrive.27_lich_tower.1: The Lich's tower. This lich wove my root into his own chest, thinking he would become immortal. His spells strike from afar: approach under cover.
The Void Blossom grew from my root where it touched the End. Never stand still: spikes grow under your feet.
expedition.story.arrive.29_nether_gauntl: The Nether Gauntlet. A fist that held my root in its grip. Literally. Strike the red eye when the palm opens.
expedition.story.arrive.30_obsidilith.1: The Obsidilith's arena. A stone that sealed my root against the void. While its runes glow, blows are useless.
expedition.story.arrive.31_wither.1: A sanctum in the Nether realm. The Wither is the first of the Ancients to drink from me. Come near and it rises.
expedition.story.arrive.32_warped_nest.1: The warped fungussus nest. A fungus of the warped wood grew through my root and decided the root was its own. Keep clear of the spores.
expedition.story.arrive.33_umvuthana_gro: The Umvuthana grove. Chief Umvuthi prayed to me for ages; now he prays only to himself. The crane priests shield him: kill them first.
expedition.story.arrive.34_monastery.1: The Sculptor's monastery. He carved my guardians from stone when the world was young. First he will test you on his pillar.
expedition.story.arrive.35_sandworm_nest: The sandworm's nest. The worm swallowed my root when the desert grew onto the seams, and has not stopped since. Stand on stone: on sand it hears you.
expedition.story.arrive.36_ruined_pyrami: The ruined pyramid. The Dune Sentinel kept the sands until the sands became strange to it. The storm is its voice.
expedition.story.arrive.37_ancient_stron: The ancient stronghold. Its guardian is a machine older than your kind, built to hold my root in stone. Hide from its beam behind a pillar.
expedition.story.arrive.38_lava_eater_sp: The lava eater's den. It drinks the Nether's fire along with my sap. Strike when it surfaces.
The yeti's hideout. The yeti is a beast of the snows I set by a root to keep it from freezing. A foolish idea.
The Frostmaw's den. The Frostmaw is an ancient beast of winter, keeper of the coldest of my roots.
expedition.story.arrive.41_skeletosaurus: The skeletosaurus nest. The bones of a beast that died out before your kind had names. I left a root in them so they would not fall apart.
expedition.story.arrive.42_soul_fortress: The remains of the soul fortress. The Withered Abomination is what grew where my root rotted in foreign soil.
The infernal dragon's tower. The dragon of the Nether is the younger brother of the one in the End. Just as greedy.
expedition.story.arrive.44_shulker_tower: The shulker tower. The Endersent is a spawn of chorus that grew along my root like ivy.
expedition.story.arrive.45_cloudy_temple: The cloudy temple. The cloud golem guards my root at the very top. Do not fight near the edge: the wind will throw you off.
expedition.story.arrive.46_collapsed_kin: The collapsed kingdom. The paladin swore to me while the kingdom still stood. The kingdom fell; the oath did not. Strike right after his swing.
expedition.story.arrive.47_lich_prison.1: The lich's prison. This lich raises the dead with my sap. Thin them out, then strike him.
expedition.story.arrive.48_ancient_tower: The ruins of the ancient tower. The Obliterator is a weapon of the Ancients aimed at my trunk. Its volleys fall in rows: move across them.
expedition.story.arrive.49_naga_courtyar: The Naga Courtyard. The Naga is the first guardian of the twilight, a serpent coiled round my root like round an egg. Fast, but clumsy on the turns.
expedition.story.arrive.50_tf_lich_tower: The Twilight Lich's tower. The Lich traded my roots for eternity. Shades hold his shield: break them first.
expedition.story.arrive.51_labyrinth.1: The Labyrinth. The Minoshroom is a bull with a mushroom for a mind. I set it in the labyrinth so it would never find the way out. It never did.
expedition.story.arrive.52_hydra_lair.1: The Hydra's lair. Each of the Hydra's heads holds a piece of my root. The body cannot be hurt: strike the heads.
expedition.story.arrive.53_knight_strong: The knight stronghold. The phantom knights swore to guard the Twilight Forest's root and never noticed they had died.
expedition.story.arrive.54_dark_tower.1: The dark tower. The Ur-Ghast, king of ghasts, mourns its world with tears of fire.
expedition.story.arrive.55_yeti_cave.1: The yeti cave. The Alpha Yeti leads the beasts of the twilight snows.
expedition.story.arrive.56_aurora_palace: The Aurora Palace. The Snow Queen froze my root to admire it forever.
expedition.story.arrive.57_bronze_dungeo: The bronze dungeon. The Slider is a stone guardian of the Aether, too dull to go mad. It just crushes. Only a pickaxe hurts it.
expedition.story.arrive.58_silver_dungeo: The silver dungeon. The Valkyrie Queen accepts the fight only for ten victory medals. The valkyries of this dungeon carry them.
The gold dungeon. The Sun Spirit is the Aether's flame, to which I entrusted a root. Only its own ice balls hurt it: knock them back.
expedition.story.fall.01_old_dungeon.1: One root is home. Faintly, but I feel it. It gets harder from here: for you, not for me.
expedition.story.fall.02_crypt.1: The crypt is quiet. No one troubles the dead here now. You might get used to the idea yourself.
expedition.story.fall.04_nether_fortress: The commander has gone cold. The blazes have no master now; their rods are yours.
expedition.story.fall.07_foundry.1: The machine has stopped. The root fused into it has returned to me.
The Remnant has crumbled. The sands are silent.
expedition.story.fall.09_frostbitten_tem: The golem has cracked. The root thawed and came back to me wet.
expedition.story.fall.12_kraken_ship.1: The Kraken has sunk into the deep. The root stayed.
expedition.story.fall.13_sky_whale.1: The captain has fallen. The whale is free, and carries the root to me.
Maledictus has fallen. The curse is lifted.
expedition.story.fall.17_stronghold.1: The gatekeeper has fallen. The frame is silent: the End is just a realm now.
expedition.story.fall.20_space_station.1: The Pursuer is dead. The sky is empty again.
expedition.story.fall.23_acropolis.1: Scylla has fallen. The sea is calm.
expedition.story.fall.28_void_blossom.1: The blossom has withered. The root is mine again.
expedition.story.fall.29_nether_gauntlet: The gauntlet has opened. The root fell straight back to me.
expedition.story.fall.30_obsidilith.1: The Obsidilith has cracked. The seal is lifted, by my will at last.
expedition.story.fall.32_warped_nest.1: The fungussus is down. The root is pulled from its mycelium. The Nether wood did not like that neighbour either.
expedition.story.fall.33_umvuthana_grove: The masks sing no more. The chief got what he prayed for: he is with me for good now.
expedition.story.fall.34_monastery.1: The Sculptor is frozen in his own stone. Ironic. I appreciate it.
expedition.story.fall.35_sandworm_nest.1: The worm is dead. The root came out of it unharmed. The worm was less lucky.
The Dune Sentinel crumbled into sand. The desert is just a desert again.
expedition.story.fall.37_ancient_strongh: The machine has stopped. The stone has let the root go.
expedition.story.fall.38_lava_eater_spaw: The eater will not surface again. Lava is just lava again.
expedition.story.fall.39_yeti_hideout.1: The yeti will not wake again. The snow has let the root go.
expedition.story.fall.40_frostmaw_den.1: The maw has shut for good. The cold has stepped back.
expedition.story.fall.41_skeletosaurus_n: The bones have crumbled. The root outlived them, as always.
expedition.story.fall.42_soul_fortress.1: The abomination is dead. The rot has receded.
expedition.story.fall.43_dragon_tower.1: The dragon has crashed down. Its fire has gone cold.
expedition.story.fall.44_shulker_tower.1: The Endersent has fallen. The chorus reaches for the root no more.
expedition.story.fall.45_cloudy_temple.1: The golem has scattered into cloud.
expedition.story.fall.46_collapsed_kingd: The paladin is free of his oath. He has earned rest more than you have.
expedition.story.fall.47_lich_prison.1: The lich has fallen. The dead lie still again.
expedition.story.fall.48_ancient_tower.1: The Obliterator is destroyed. That weapon will fire no more.
The Naga has fallen. The Twilight Forest remembers whom it belongs to. Not you, of course.
expedition.story.fall.50_tf_lich_tower.1: The Lich has fallen. Eternity turned out shorter than he thought.
expedition.story.fall.51_labyrinth.1: The Minoshroom has fallen. The labyrinth is empty.
expedition.story.fall.52_hydra_lair.1: The Hydra has fallen. The heads no longer quarrel over the root.
expedition.story.fall.53_knight_strongho: The phantoms are gone. The oath is fulfilled.
expedition.story.fall.54_dark_tower.1: The Ur-Ghast is silent. Its tears have dried.
expedition.story.fall.55_yeti_cave.1: The Alpha has fallen. The pack will scatter.
expedition.story.fall.56_aurora_palace.1: The Queen has melted. The root flows again.
The Slider has crumbled. The Aether lets you in. Believe me, it is no honour.
The Queen fell with honour. A rarity among my guardians.
expedition.story.fall.59_gold_dungeon.1: The Sun Spirit has gone out. The golden island is cooling.
expedition.story.finale.2: I wither no more. The seams hold: my roots have stitched the world right through.
expedition.story.finale.3: The worlds stay together. Better so: they are easier to watch.
expedition.story.finale.4: I admit it: you made a decent tool. Better than the others lying in that earth.
expedition.story.finale.5: You may stay. The world is yours, for as long as I allow it.
expedition.story.finale.6: If the guardians wake again, the reset beacon will find them. And I will hear you at any fire. Do not abuse it.
expedition.story.finale.title: The Stitched World
expedition.story.outro.03_wrought_chambe: The empty armour has fallen. The root slid out of it cleanly, like a blade from its sheath.
You see? It took neither wit nor courage. Only patience, and someone else's back.
expedition.story.outro.05_mossy_temple.1: The Colossus crumbled into moss. The root is warm; it slept a long time.
expedition.story.outro.05_mossy_temple.2: The jungle no longer holds what is not its own. Move on while I am in the mood.
expedition.story.outro.06_underworld_are: The Knight has knelt. He kept his oath to the very end.
Only the dragon is left. It remembers me. I remember it. This will not be pretty.
expedition.story.outro.10_ocean_monument: The Coralssus has crumbled. The root rose to me through all that water.
The first chapter is done. Do not be proud: I expected less of you, and still do.
expedition.story.outro.11_pirate_ship.1: Cornelia has finally drowned for real. The root came back salty.
expedition.story.outro.11_pirate_ship.2: Do not pity her crew. I do not.
Ignis has gone out. The arena is cooling.
My fire has come back to me. Let yours burn while it can.
expedition.story.outro.15_soul_blacksmit: The forge has gone quiet. The Monstrosity gave up the root as one pays a debt.
It forged for me for ages. The dead give no thanks, and neither shall I.
expedition.story.outro.18_ender_dragon.2: It was my first. I set it over the void so the End would not drift away.
expedition.story.outro.18_ender_dragon.3: Do not look at me like that. I do not grieve. Trees do not grieve.
expedition.story.outro.19_ruined_citadel: The citadel is empty. The root of the End has returned.
Halfway. I am beginning to think something may come of you. Do not flatter yourself.
expedition.story.outro.21_ancient_factor: The Harbinger is down. Its factory was a loom that tore my roots.
One of the Ancients. The other two know you are coming.
expedition.story.outro.22_sunken_city.1: The Leviathan has sunk for good.
expedition.story.outro.22_sunken_city.2: The water remembers me. Now it is mine again.
expedition.story.outro.24_malkuth.2: One branch has returned. I can feel the earth again.
expedition.story.outro.25_chesed.2: One more branch. I remember what it is to grow.
expedition.story.outro.27_lich_tower.1: The Lich is dead. His immortality has come back to me as a root.
expedition.story.outro.27_lich_tower.2: One more who mistook my strength for his own.
expedition.story.outro.31_wither.1: The Wither is dead. It was the first to let the Rift in.
expedition.story.outro.31_wither.2: Take its star. Let it be good for something at least.
expedition.story.prologue.aether.1: Above the clouds, the islands of the Aether. The valkyries let no one in. Not even me, to be honest.
expedition.story.prologue.camp.1: Here, to my withered trunk, an expedition once came. They all lie beneath my roots. So do you.
expedition.story.prologue.end.1: And at the very edge, the void of the End. There I set the dragon, my first knot, so the End would not drift away.
expedition.story.prologue.nether.1: Beneath it I held the Nether: seas of lava and black fortresses where blazes guarded my fire.
expedition.story.prologue.overworld.1: Once I held six worlds apart, each on a branch of its own. Yours is the dullest: forests, mountains and people.
expedition.story.prologue.seam.1: Then came the Rift and split my trunk. The worlds fell onto one another and grew together at the seams, and my guardians went mad.
expedition.story.prologue.title: The Stitched World
expedition.story.prologue.twilight.1: In endless twilight I hid a forest without a sun. The naga, the lich and the hydra kept it at my word.
item.expedition.guiding_seed.desc: A seed of the Tree that remembers the way. Throw it into a lit campfire: the seed takes its fire, and the flame grows towards a guardian
expedition.seed.none: The flame burns still: no guardian is open
expedition.route.60_brass_dungeon.title: The Brass Dungeon
expedition.route.60_brass_dungeon.text: The sky islands. The Eye of the Storm dwells in the brass dungeon.
expedition.route.61_ancient_temple.title: The Ancient Temple of the Otherside
expedition.route.61_ancient_temple.text: The Otherside. A Stalker hunts in the sculk-grown temple.
expedition.story.arrive.60_brass_dungeon: The brass dungeon. The Eye of the Storm whirls the winds around my root. Strike its rings.
expedition.story.fall.60_brass_dungeon.1: The storm has settled. The sky over the islands is calm.
expedition.story.arrive.61_ancient_templ: The Ancient Temple of the Otherside. The Warden of the Deep is a blind guardian that hears the sap flowing in my root. Move quietly.
The Warden sleeps for good. Even the Otherside has gone quiet.
expedition.story.wrath.1.1: A hand against me? I raised you from the grave. I can put you back.
expedition.story.wrath.2.1: I held six worlds apart. Your axe does not impress me.
expedition.story.wrath.3.1: Once more, and I will forget where I buried you.
death.attack.expedition.tree_wrath: %1$s was struck down by the Tree
expedition.guide.name: Expedition Guide
expedition.guide.landing: A guide to the stitched world: what this world is, what to do first, how your gear grows and where the story leads.$(br2)Story chapters open as you play.
expedition.guide.cat.way.desc: What to make and where to look
expedition.guide.expedition.world.page0: The Rift stitched the worlds into one: the Overworld, the $(l)Twilight Forest$(), the $(l)Nether$(), the $(l)Otherside$(), the $(l)End$() and the $(l)Aether$(). They are realms of one world now, and their guardians have gone mad.
expedition.guide.expedition.world.page1: There are no portals: every realm is reached on foot or by ship. Around the landing lies the ordinary world, the realms further out. The further from the camp, the stronger the foes and the richer the chests.$(br2)The world ends at an icy ridge.
expedition.guide.expedition.chapters.pag: The story goes in $(l)chapters$(). Each opens several dungeons with guardians at once, to be taken in any order.$(br2)When $(l)three quarters$() of a chapter's guardians have fallen, the next chapter opens by itself.

The $(l)fireseed$() shows the way: throw it into a lit campfire. The fire goes out and a trail of flame reaches for the nearest guardian still standing. Light the campfire again to throw another.$(br2)Fireseeds: seeds, redstone and coal.

The story is one for the whole server. A fallen guardian is marked with a skull on everyone's map.$(br2)The story's progress, the chapters and all guardians are in the advancements, under "The Stitched World".
expedition.guide.expedition.garrisons.pa: There are no spawners. Each dungeon has its own $(l)garrison$(): a stock of foes by the building's size. They come a few at a time until the stock runs out; the bar on top of the screen shows how many are left.

While the garrison stands, the dungeon's walls don't break and nothing can be built inside.$(br2)Garrison foes drop $(l)trophies$() and Create parts. They also carry the dungeon's $(l)special loot$(): a piece now and then, and the last one gives up all that is left.
expedition.guide.expedition.bosses.page0: Guardians and bosses drop no ready weapons. Each leaves a $(l)heart$() bearing its name: Create machines turn it into that boss's gear.
expedition.guide.expedition.bosses.page1: The $(l)beacon of return$() revives a cleared dungeon: the same garrison, stronger (NG+), and its guardian gives a heart again.$(br2)Beacon: brass, a precision mechanism, electron tubes and an eye of ender on the mechanical crafter.
expedition.guide.expedition.map.page0: The minimap is always in the corner; the full map opens with $(k:key.antique_atlas.open).$(br2)Explored land is in colour, the rest a pale sketch of its biomes.
expedition.guide.expedition.map.page1: Hover over the map to see a biome.$(br2)The open chapters' dungeons are marked and named, fallen guardians with a skull.
expedition.guide.expedition.travel.page0: There is no personal flight: elytra and the like are gone. Distances are long, and the End and the Aether hang over the void, so travel is by $(l)Create Aeronautics ships$().
expedition.guide.expedition.travel.page1: Lift comes from hot air (a burner and envelopes of wool) or levitite, thrust from propellers on Create rotation. A first ship is within reach by chapter II, once there is brass.$(br2)Wool comes from sheep and chests.
expedition.guide.expedition.death.page0: On death a $(l)grave$() with all your things stays where you fell: come back to it and take them.$(br2)Don't hack at the $(l)Tree$() in the camp: it answers with lightning.
expedition.guide.way.create.page0: Nearly everything is made with $(l)Create$() machines.$(br2)$(l)1. Andesite$(): andesite alloy, a water wheel or windmill, shafts, a millstone and crushing wheels (more from ore), a press (sheets), a mixer.
expedition.guide.way.create.page1: $(l)2. Brass$(): needs a $(l)blaze burner$(). Blazes live in Nether fortresses (chapter II). Brass gives electron tubes, the mechanical crafter and ships.$(br2)$(l)3. Precision mechanism$(): sequenced assembly.
expedition.guide.way.create.page2: $(l)4. Sturdy sheets$() (powdered obsidian) and $(l)TFMG steel$() with its $(l)steel mechanism$(): netherite and the bosses' strongest gear.$(br2)Don't know how to make something? Look it up in JEI: every recipe shows its machine.
expedition.guide.way.armor.page0: $(l)Chapters I-II$(): iron. Tools and armor from iron sheets on a crafting table.$(br2)$(l)Chapters III-IV$(): diamond. Diamonds are in farther dungeons' chests; the gear takes the mechanical crafter and a precision mechanism.
expedition.guide.way.armor.page1: $(l)Chapters V-VII$(): netherite. Netherite scrap is in farther dungeons' chests; the ingot is mixed over a superheated burner. The upgrade is made on the mechanical crafter with a steel mechanism.$(br2)Boss gear is stronger: a bonus on top of this ladder.
expedition.guide.way.trophies.page0: Trophies go by the foe: undead $(l)grave dust$(), arthropods $(l)chitin$(), raiders a $(l)raider insignia$(), aquatic $(l)abyssal scale$(), the Nether a $(l)cinder core$(), the End a $(l)void shard$(), the rest a $(l)feral fang$().
expedition.guide.way.trophies.page1: Trophies are mixed into Apotheosis rarity materials: scrap, timeworn fabric, luminous crystal, arcane sands. These make gems, affixes, $(l)relics and artifacts$(): none are in chests, all are made on the mechanical crafter.
expedition.guide.way.trophies.page2: $(l)Boss hearts$(): the boss's own gear, godforged pearls and the strongest relics. The strongest things need hearts of later chapters' guardians.$(br2)Chests give everyday materials, not ready things.
expedition.guide.way.act_1.page0: The Old Dungeon, the Crypt, the Wrought Chamber and the Ocean Monument.$(br2)First trophies: dust, chitin, fangs, scales.
expedition.guide.way.act_1.page1: Build andesite machines and iron gear and get ready for the Nether: brass comes next.
expedition.guide.way.act_2: Chapter II. Fire under the seams
expedition.guide.way.act_2.page0: $(l)Nether Fortress$(): blazes for the burner, so brass.$(br2)Mossy Temple: nature crystal. Ship in the ice: frozen key, treasure pouch.
expedition.guide.way.act_2.page1: Also: the Warped Fungussus Nest, the Umvuthana Grove and the Naga Courtyard in the Twilight Forest.$(br2)By the chapter's end: brass, the mechanical crafter, a first ship.
expedition.guide.way.act_3: Chapter III. Above the clouds and the void
expedition.guide.way.act_3.page0: $(l)Ender Dragon$(): eye of ender, dragon head, enchanted golden apple.$(br2)$(l)Frostbitten Temple$(): frozen rune.$(br2)Time to move to diamond and the precision mechanism.
expedition.guide.way.act_3.page1: Also: the Underworld Arena, Foundry, Stronghold, Sculptor's Monastery, the Sandworm and Lava Eater nests, Ruined Pyramid, Ancient Stronghold, Twilight Lich Tower, the Aether's Bronze Dungeon.
expedition.guide.way.act_4.page0: $(l)Kraken Ship$(): kraken tooth.$(br2)$(l)Lich Tower$(): ancient anima and diamonds.
expedition.guide.way.act_4.page1: Also: the Sky Whale, Ruined Citadel, Nether Gauntlet, the yeti, Frostmaw, skeletosaurus, soul fortress, Infernal Dragon, shulker tower, Labyrinth, Hydra, the Aether's Silver and Brass dungeons.
expedition.guide.way.act_5: Chapter V. Forges and the void
expedition.guide.way.act_5.page0: $(l)Burning Arena$(): ignitium ingot.$(br2)$(l)Soul Blacksmith$(): lava power cell, monstrous horn.$(br2)$(l)Void Blossom$(): crystal fruit, void thorn.
expedition.guide.way.act_5.page1: Also: the Space Station, Obsidilith, Cloudy Temple, Collapsed Kingdom, phantom knights' stronghold, Dark Tower, the Aether's Gold Dungeon, the Otherside's Ancient Temple.$(br2)Time to move to netherite.
expedition.guide.way.act_6.page0: $(l)Cursed Pyramid$(): ancient metal, remnant skull, sandstorm in a bottle.$(br2)$(l)Frosted Prison$(): cursium ingot.$(br2)$(l)Ancient Factory$(): witherite.
expedition.guide.way.act_6.page1: $(l)Sunken City$(): abyssal egg.$(br2)$(l)Wither$(): nether star.$(br2)Also: the Lich Prison, the ancient tower's ruins, Yeti Cave, Aurora Palace.
expedition.guide.way.act_7.page0: Scylla's $(l)Acropolis$(): essence of the storm, lacrima.$(br2)The last three guardians: $(l)Malkuth$(), $(l)Chesed$() and $(l)Geburah$().
expedition.guide.way.act_7.page1: Their cores: fire and ice (Malkuth), lightning (Chesed), justice (Geburah).$(br2)When all three fall, the seam closes.
expedition.guide.cat.start.desc: The world, the story and first steps
expedition.guide.welcome.page0: The worlds once stood apart: the Overworld, the Twilight Forest, the Nether, the Otherside, the End and the Aether. The Rift stitched them into one. Now they are $(l)realms$() of one world, and their guardian bosses have gone mad. The stitched world ends at a ridge of ice: beyond it the Rift lets no one pass.
expedition.guide.welcome.page1: The story comes in $(l)chapters$(). A chapter opens several dungeons and bosses at once. They can be done in any order. The way is shown by a $(l)fireseed$(), a seed of the Tree: throw it into a lit campfire: the seed takes the fire (the campfire goes out) and the flame grows towards a guardian. Light the campfire again for the next one. Fireseeds are made from seeds, redstone and coal.$(br2)Every dungeon of a chapter has its guardian. When it falls, the dungeon's place is marked with a skull on every player's map, and the fireseed leads on to the next. When three quarters of a chapter's guardians have fallen, the next chapter opens by itself. The fireseed leads from the easy guardians to the hard.
expedition.guide.welcome.page2: The server has one story for everyone. A dungeon done can be done again: the $(l)reset beacon$() revives it stronger (NG+).
expedition.guide.welcome.page3: Story progress shows in the advancements, tab "The Stitched World", along with the chapter order and every guardian. The Story section of this book grows with each chapter.
expedition.guide.first_steps.page0: Wood, stone, shelter: as usual. After that everything rests on $(l)Create$().$(br2)1. Andesite alloy: andesite and iron nuggets.$(br)2. A water wheel or windmill, shafts, cogs.$(br)3. Millstone and crusher: ore gives more.$(br)4. Press: sheets for gear.$(br)5. Mixer and basin.
expedition.guide.first_steps.page1: Iron and gold tools and armour are made from Create $(l)sheets$() at a crafting table. Diamond and up needs the mechanical crafter and precision mechanisms.$(br2)Dungeon chests give common materials, not finished items: everything worth having is made by hand and machine.
expedition.guide.realms.page0: The world is made of huge areas. Ordinary biomes span kilometres. Between them lie $(l)realms$(): each is one biome of a former world, just as big.
expedition.guide.realms.page1: $(l)Twilight Forest$(): eternal dusk, guardians of its own.$(br)$(l)Nether$(): scorched land and lava lakes under the open sky.$(br)$(l)Otherside$(): sculk lands.$(br)$(l)End$(): islands over the void, do not fall.$(br)$(l)Aether$(): islands high in the sky, void below.
expedition.guide.realms.page2: There are no portals any more: every realm can be reached on foot or by air. The landing site is always surrounded by ordinary land; all realms lie a few kilometres away.
expedition.guide.airships.page0: Distances are long here, and the End and the Aether hang over the void. So the main way to travel is $(l)Create Aeronautics airships$().
expedition.guide.airships.page1: Lift comes from hot air (a $(item)burner$() and wool $(item)envelopes$()) or $(item)levitite$(). Thrust comes from $(item)propellers$() on bearings, powered by Create rotation.$(br2)A first ship is realistic by chapter II, once you have brass.
expedition.guide.airships.page2: Wool in dungeon buildings is replaced by worn canvas that drops nothing. Get wool from sheep and chests.
expedition.guide.map.page0: The minimap is always in the corner; the full map opens with M.$(br2)Explored land is drawn in colour, one dot per block. Unexplored land is a faint sketch of biomes: you can see where forest, sea or a realm lies.
expedition.guide.map.page1: Hover over the map to see the biome's name. Red crosses are the dungeons and lairs of the story chapters, each one labelled.
expedition.guide.garrisons.page0: Dungeons have no spawners. Each dungeon has its own $(l)garrison$(): a stock of enemies sized by the building and its chests. They come a few at a time until the stock runs out.
expedition.guide.garrisons.page1: While the garrison lives, the dungeon's walls cannot be broken or blown up and nothing can be built inside. When the last enemy falls, the dungeon is $(l)cleared$(): the garrison bar is shown on screen.$(br2)Garrison enemies drop $(l)trophies$(): dust, chitin, raider insignia, scales, cinder cores, void shards, fangs. Almost all advanced gear rests on trophies.
expedition.guide.bosses.page0: Bosses do not drop finished weapons. Each leaves a $(l)heart$() bearing its name.$(br2)On Create machines hearts become the boss's gear, rare Apotheosis materials and relics.
expedition.guide.bosses.page1: The $(l)reset beacon$() revives a cleared dungeon: the same garrison, only stronger. That is how you get a heart again.
expedition.guide.loot.page0: Chests hold common materials: string, leather, paper, andesite, logs, nuggets, raw ore, gunpowder, redstone. The farther from the landing site, the more valuable: quartz and pearls, then diamonds, netherite, echo shards.
expedition.guide.loot.page1: Chests hold no finished gear, artifacts or relics: those are made, not found.
expedition.guide.create_pipeline.page0: $(l)Andesite$(): alloy, shafts, press, millstone. Iron and gold items from sheets.$(br2)$(l)Brass$(): needs a blaze burner (rods from Nether fortresses). Brass gives the mechanical crafter, electron tubes and airships.
expedition.guide.create_pipeline.page1: $(l)Precision mechanism$() (sequenced assembly): diamond gear.$(br2)$(l)Sturdy sheets$() (obsidian powder) and $(l)TFMG steel$(): netherite gear and the strongest boss weapons.
expedition.guide.create_pipeline.page2: If you do not know how something is made, look it up in JEI: every recipe shows its machine.
expedition.guide.relics.page0: $(l)Relics$() and $(l)artifacts$() drop from neither chests nor mobs. They are built on the $(l)mechanical crafter$(): a base, two trophies, two rarity materials and Create parts.
expedition.guide.relics.page1: Relics level up as you use them. Unlock their abilities as they grow.$(br2)The strongest relics and artifacts need hearts of late-chapter bosses.
expedition.guide.apotheosis.page0: Affixed gear and Apotheosis gems do not drop. Rarity materials are made through Create:$(br2)Mysterious scrap: a trophy and an iron sheet in a mixer.$(br)Timeworn fabric: heated (dust, chitin, fang).$(br)Luminous crystal: heated (scale, raider insignia).$(br)Arcane sands: superheated (cinder core, void shard).$(br)Godforged pearl: a boss heart on the mechanical crafter.
expedition.guide.apotheosis.page1: Gems are made on the mechanical crafter and upgraded at the gem cutting table. Affixes come from the reforging table, paid in rarity materials.
expedition.guide.act_1.page0: The Rift split my trunk. The worlds fell onto one another and grew together at the seams, and I am withering. I need hands. Yours will do.
expedition.guide.act_1.page1: The landing site is ringed by the first guardians: the Old Dungeon, the Crypt, the Wrought Chamber of the Ferrous Wroughtnaut and the Ocean Monument of the Elder Guardian.$(br2)Goal: the $(l)Seam Compass$() from the Wroughtnaut's and Elder Guardian's hearts (crafting table: compass, sheets, alloy).
expedition.guide.act_2.page0: Further on the seams run hot. There the Nether grew into your forests, and in its fortresses my guardians of fire forgot whom they serve.
expedition.guide.act_2.page1: Fire beneath the seams: Cornelia's ship in the ice, a Nether fortress (blaze rods mean brass!), the fungussus nest, the Umvuthana grove, the Colossus's mossy temple, the Naga courtyard in the Twilight Forest.$(br2)Goal: the $(l)Brass Astrolabe$() from Cornelia's and the Colossus's hearts (mechanical crafter).
expedition.guide.act_2: Chapter II. Fire beneath the seams
expedition.guide.act_3.page0: Here the End and the Aether grew onto the seams. Their guardians hold my roots above the clouds and over the void.
expedition.guide.act_3.page1: The sky road: deserts, an ice temple, a foundry, a stronghold, the Underworld Knight's arena, the Twilight Lich, the Aether bronze dungeon and the dragon of the End on its island.$(br2)Goal: the $(l)Rift Eye$() from the dragon's and the Underworld Knight's hearts (precision mechanisms).
expedition.guide.act_3: Chapter III. Above the clouds and the void
expedition.guide.act_4.page0: Further on the seams tear harder: a whale in the sky, the Kraken's ship, the liches' towers. The knots there are thicker and angrier.
expedition.guide.act_4.page1: The torn lands: the yeti, Frostmaw, the skeletosaurus, the soul fortress, the sky whale, the Lich tower, the Nether gauntlet, the infernal dragon, the Kraken, the Ender Guardian's citadel, the Minoshroom labyrinth, the Hydra, the Aether silver dungeon.$(br2)Goal: the $(l)Sky Anchor$() from the Ender Guardian's and the Lich's hearts.
expedition.guide.act_5.page0: Ignis and the Netherite Monstrosity are my smiths. Once they forged order. Now they forge only spite.
expedition.guide.act_5.page1: Forges and the void: the soul forge, Ignis's burning arena, the cloud temple, the fallen kingdom, the void blossom, the Obsidilith, the space station, the knight phantom stronghold, the Dark Tower, the Aether gold dungeon.$(br2)Goal: the $(l)Void Crucible$() from Ignis's and the Netherite Monstrosity's hearts.
expedition.guide.act_5: Chapter V. Forges and the void
expedition.guide.act_6.page0: It was they who let the Rift in: they tore at my roots to be free. Freedom does not suit them.
expedition.guide.act_6.page1: The Ancients: the Harbinger's ancient factory, the Leviathan's sunken city, the Wither in its Nether sanctum, the cursed pyramid, the frosted prison, the Lich prison, the ancient tower ruins, the yeti cave and the Aurora palace.$(br2)Goal: the $(l)Seed of the Tree$() from the Harbinger's, Leviathan's and Wither's hearts and a Nether star.
expedition.guide.act_7.page0: They have not gone mad. They hold what is left, and will not give it up without a fight.
expedition.guide.act_7.page1: The Tree: Scylla's Acropolis and the three last guardians, Malkuth, Chesed and Geburah.$(br2)When all three fall, the seam closes.
expedition.guide.finale.page0: I wither no more. The seams hold: my roots have stitched the world right through.
expedition.guide.finale.page1: I admit it: you made a decent tool. Better than the others lying in that earth.
